note: Large forested area in northeast Dent County between Salem and Steelville, laced with gravel area roads. Camping is at five designated camping areas beside those roads, in the woods with no pads or amenities. --Claude
summary: Confirmed with a padless caveat: page 'Designated Camping Sites / Individual Campsites', Rule 140 standard; map (03/18) 5 'Designated Camping Area' symbols on gravel area roads, none at the two lots; GIS 364 = stored pin, a dirt spur off the road 10-17 gravel road. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT caveat: the area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites, Individual Campsites'. Rule 140 is standard, with no special-use-permit-only rule and no Rule 101. The map (03/18) draws five 'Designated Camping Area' symbols on the gravel area roads, at the north end (by food plot 3), on road 10-30, at the east end on 10-17, by food plot 23, and on 10-28. None is at either parking lot, and the privies are only at the two lots. Imagery at the stored pin (GIS 364) shows a dirt spur about 30 m long leaving the gravel road into a pine stand, with a vehicle parked on it, about 40 m NW of the GIS point. GIS 363 and 365 sit 40-80 m from gravel roads under canopy, with no clearing visible. This is padless roadside camping: it stays, with the caveat that a 23-ft rig needs a dry gravel road and a short dirt pull-off.
PIN: the stored 37.72570,-91.31453 is GIS point 364. Keep it. The drivable spur is about 40 m NW, at about 37.72592,-91.31488, if a finer pin is wanted.
CLUSTERS: five single points spread over about 7 km, each on its own gravel area road. They're the same kind of spot, so no split is proposed. near.py finds no other entry nearby.
HORSES: the area page lists no horse camp or equestrian trail.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the area's only water is the pond by the lot and wildlife water holes. The pin is in upland pine.
PHONE: (573) 368-2225 on the area page matches.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. The 2027 MDC permit is in the policy row and isn't written per entry.
NOTE: rewritten. Dropped the acreage, the 14-day limit (now booking.max_stay_nights), 'site length not published', 'MDC maps 5 camping spots' and the driving directions.
